records.summary: Inbar at the Akko branch applied for renewal and citizenship 3 months ahead, got the citizenship meeting and interview in one meeting a month before the renewal date, the visa was not renewed as it had a month left, and the ceremony and passport application followed 3 weeks later.

waits.text: 3 weeks after and before the renewal we had the citizenship ceremony

practices: Holds the citizenship interview in the same meeting where the last documents are handed in.
Does not renew the A5 when it still has a month of validity and the citizenship answer is due within that time.
